title: Main asteroid belt
note: Representative population sampled from 2.2–3.2 AU on the common linear distance scale. Synthetic rock sizes and phases are illustrative; this is not an asteroid catalogue.

title: Kuiper Belt
placement: Beyond Neptune; main region approximately 30–50 AU
note: Sampled between 30 and 50 AU using the same linear scale. The scattered disk and Oort Cloud are excluded. Population and object sizes are illustrative.

title: Zodiacal dust cloud
placement: Diffuse inner Solar System disk near the orbital plane
note: Dust scatters sunlight. The warm haze and sparse motes are enhanced explanatory graphics; the rendered outer fade is not a physical boundary.

title: Enceladus water-vapour torus
placement: Around Saturn, concentrated near Enceladus’s orbit
note: Water vapour from Enceladus spreads into a torus. The blue colour and opacity are illustrative visibility enhancements, not its naked-eye appearance.

title: Saturn E ring and Enceladus plume
placement: Diffuse icy ring around Saturn; jets from Enceladus’s south pole
note: Ice grains supply the E ring, while water vapour supplies the gas torus. These are distinct but related components, shown in the same physical neighbourhood.
